title: Telling Time & Making Appointments
description: Learn to talk about time and schedule meetings
objectives: Ask and tell the time (What time is it?)
Make appointments (When is...? / At what time...?)
Use basic time expressions (morning, afternoon, evening)
Talk about days of the week

target_language.grammar_pattern:
What time is it?
It is + time

When is + event?
At + time
On + day

Examples:
- What time is it?
- It is 3 o'clock
- When is the appointment?
- At 2 PM
- On Monday

grammar_patterns.label: Asking the time
examples: Excuse me, what time is it?

story.context: You need to see a doctor. You call the clinic to make an appointment.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Good morning. City Clinic. How can I help you?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Hello. I need to make an appointment.

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Okay. When do you want to come?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Yes. What time is good for you?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: I have 9 AM or 11 AM. Which one?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Perfect. Monday at 9 AM. What is your name?

dialogue.speaker: Receptionist
dialogue.text: Great. See you on Monday at 9 AM.

speaking.title: Task 1: Tell the time
speaking.instruction: Record yourself telling these times: 9 AM, 2 PM, 6 o'clock
speaking.example: It is 9 AM. It is 2 PM. It is 6 o'clock.

speaking.title: Task 2: Make an appointment
speaking.instruction: Record yourself making a doctor's appointment for Monday at 10 AM.
speaking.example:
You: I need to make an appointment.
Receptionist: When?
You: Monday at 10 AM, please.

writing.instruction: Write 5 appointments with day and time.

1. Monday at 9 AM
2. Tuesday at 2 PM
3. Wednesday at 11 AM
4. Thursday at 3 PM

writing.title: Task 2: Write an appointment conversation
writing.instruction: Write a conversation (8-10 lines) where you call to make an appointment at a clinic.
writing.example:
Receptionist: City Clinic. How can I help you?
You: I need to make an appointment.
Receptionist: When do you want to come?
You: Can I come on Tuesday?
Receptionist: Yes. What time?
You: In the afternoon, please.
Receptionist: 2 PM or 4 PM?
You: 2 PM is good.
Receptionist: Great. Tuesday at 2 PM.
You: Thank you!

sections.title: Asking about time
sections.question: What words do we use to ask about time?
sections.explanation: We use 'What time' or 'When' to ask about time. These are question words for time.

sections.title: Prepositions with time
sections.question: What small words come before times and days?
sections.explanation: We use 'at' for specific times (at 9 AM), 'on' for days (on Monday), and 'in' for parts of the day (in the morning).

sections.title: Time expressions
sections.question: How do we talk about different parts of the day?
sections.explanation: We use AM for morning times (before noon) and PM for afternoon/evening times (after noon). We can also say 'in the morning', 'in the afternoon', 'in the evening', or 'at night'.

sections.title: Telling the Time
sections.question: How do we say what time it is?
sections.explanation: Use 'It is + [time]' to tell the time. For the hour alone, add 'o'clock' (3 o'clock). For AM/PM times, just say the numbers (9 AM, 11:30).

quiz.question: You want to know the time. What do you ask?
quiz.explanation: 'What time is it?' is the correct question for asking the time.

quiz.question: It is 9 in the morning. You say:
quiz.explanation: 9 in the morning is '9 AM'. AM means morning times.

quiz.question: Your appointment is Monday at 2 PM. Which is CORRECT?
quiz.explanation: We say 'on Monday at 2 PM'. Use 'on' for days and 'at' for specific times.

quiz.question: Fill in the blank: I have an appointment ___ 3 PM.
quiz.explanation: We use 'at' for specific times. 'At 3 PM' is correct.

quiz.question: Fill in the blank: The appointment is ___ Monday.
quiz.explanation: We use 'on' for days of the week. 'On Monday' is correct.

quiz.question: It is 6 in the evening. You say:
quiz.explanation: 6 in the evening is '6 PM'. PM means afternoon/evening times.

quiz.question: You want to make an appointment in the afternoon. You say:
quiz.explanation: We say 'in the afternoon'. Use 'in' for parts of the day.

quiz.question: Which is CORRECT?
options: See you on Monday at 9 AM
See you in Monday at 9 AM
See you at Monday on 9 AM
quiz.explanation: 'See you on Monday at 9 AM' is correct. Use 'on' with days.

quiz.question: Write a 6-line conversation where you make a dentist appointment for Tuesday at 3 PM.
quiz.explanation: Your conversation should include: requesting an appointment, suggesting a day and time, and confirming the appointment.

quiz.question: Think about your schedule. Write 3 real appointments you have (or need to make) with the day and time.
quiz.explanation: Practice using real information from your life. Example: Doctor appointment on Wednesday at 10 AM.

somali.description: Baro sida wakhtiga looga hadlo, ballamahana loo qabsado
objectives: Waydii oo sheeg wakhtiga (What time is it?)
Samee ballamo (When is...? / At what time...?)
Isticmaal erayada wakhtiga aasaasiga ah (morning, afternoon, evening)

sections.explanation: 'What time' ama 'When' waxaan u isticmaalnaa si aan wakhtiga u waydiinno. Kuwani waa erayada su'aalaha wakhtiga.
'at' waxaan u isticmaalnaa saacado gaar ah (at 9 AM), 'on' maalmaha (on Monday), 'in'-na qaybaha maalinta (in the morning).

AM waxaan u isticmaalnaa wakhtiyada subaxa (duhurka ka hor), PM-na galabta iyo fiidka (duhurka ka dib). Waxaan sidoo kale odhan karnaa 'in the morning', 'in the afternoon', 'in the evening', ama 'at night'.
Isticmaal 'It is + [time]' si aad u sheegto waqtiga. Haddii ay tahay saacad dhammaystiran, ku dar 'o'clock' (3 o'clock). Waqtiyada AM/PM, kaliya dheh tirooyinka (9 AM, 11:30).

target_phrases: What time is it? = Waa imisa saacad?
When is the appointment? = Goorma ayay tahay ballanka?
In the morning / afternoon / evening = Subaxnimo / galabnimo / fiidnimo
dialogue: Subax wanaagsan. City Clinic. Sideen ku caawin karaa?
Hello. Waxaan u baahanahay in aan ballan sameeyo.
Hagaag. Goormaad rabtaa in aad timaado?
Haa. Waqti intee ayaa kuu fiican?
Waxaan haystaa 9 AM ama 11 AM. Kee?
Waa fiican. Isniinta 9 AM ayaan ku arki.
